resources.label: Everyday object evidence
resources.oneSubmissionNote: Use ordinary safe objects from home, an office or a classroom. Do not include confidential or personal information.

preferred.label: 1 clear photo
preferred.instruction: Choose three safe everyday objects, organise them into a sensible group and take one clear photo of the result.

preferred.label: 1 short audio statement
preferred.instruction: Explain what the objects are, what they are used for and why you grouped them this way.

alternatives.label: Video alternative
alternatives.instruction: Record one short video showing the three objects and explaining what they are used for and why you grouped them together.

capture: Keep names, paperwork, addresses and confidential information out of view.

practical.label: Simple task evidence
practical.oneSubmissionNote: This activity is only to demonstrate how Evia captures practical evidence.

preferred.label: 1 short practical video
preferred.instruction: Record a short video showing yourself carrying out a simple safe check, sort or tidy-up task and show the finished result.

alternatives.label: If video is not practical
alternatives.instruction: Use up to 3 photos showing before, during and after, plus a short audio or written explanation.

capture: Choose a task that is safe to demonstrate.
Show the task and the finished result.

knowledge.label: Explanation evidence
knowledge.oneSubmissionNote: Keep the answer short. The purpose is to demonstrate Evia rather than assess technical knowledge.

preferred.label: 1 short audio statement
preferred.instruction: Explain your answer in your own words using the activity you just completed as the example.

alternatives.label: Written alternative
alternatives.instruction: Write a short statement instead of recording audio.

capture: Give a simple reason for your answer.
Use the demo activity as your example.
